pages.comingSoonDesc: Yeh khasiyat agle development phase mein jori jaye gi.
pages.diseaseDesc: AI computer vision ka istemal karte hue pode ke patte, phal ya fasal ki tasveer upload karein aur mumkina bimariyon ka tajziya karein. Nizam bimariyon ki nishandahi kare ga, ilaj ki tajaveez faraham kare ga, aur rok tham ke tips de ga.
pages.mandiDesc: Faslon ke dastiyab tareen mandi bhaao dekhein.
pages.checkingPrices: Taza tareen bhaao dekhe ja rahe hain...
pages.noPriceData: Is fasal aur soobay ka bhaao filhal dastiyab nahi.
pages.mandiUnavailable: Bhaao ki maloomat filhal dastiyab nahi. Baad mein dobara koshish karein.
pages.farmerRatesDesc: Aaj apni fasal ka bhaao share kar ke doosre kisano ki madad karein.
pages.rateSubmitted: Shukriya! Aap ka bhaao kamyabi se jama ho gaya hai.
pages.rateAlreadySubmitted: Aap aaj is fasal aur soobay ke liye pehle hi bhaao share kar chuke hain. Taawun ka shukriya!
pages.rateSubmitFailed: Fil hal bhaao jama nahi ho saka. Barah-e-karam dobara koshish karein.
pages.farmerReportedNote: Barah-e-raast kisano ki janib se share kiye gaye. Yeh community reports hain, sarkari tor par tasdeeq shuda bhaao nahi.
pages.noFarmerRates: Abhi is fasal aur soobay ke liye koi kisan reported bhaao mojood nahi.
pages.weedDesc: Gandum, chawal, kapas, ganna, makai, chane, aam aur aloo samait aham Pakistani faslon ke liye jari bootiyon ki nishandahi aur intizam ke jame ilm tak rasai hasil karein.
pages.assistantDesc: Humare AI farming assistant se baat karein jo English, Urdu aur Roman Urdu samajhta hai. Faslon, bimariyon, kiron, khadon aur aabpashi ke baray mein amli mashwaray hasil karein.
pages.newsDesc: Apne soobay ke liye taza tareen zarai khabron aur sarkari schemes se ba-khabar rahein.
pages.newsEmpty: Is soobay ke liye filhal koi khabar ya update dastiyab nahi hai.
pages.newsLoadError: Khabrein load nahi ho sakin. Barah-e-karam baad mein dobara koshish karein.
pages.invalidImage: JPEG, PNG ya WEBP tasveer 5 MB tak muntakhib karein.
pages.detectionUnavailable: Abhi tasveer ka tajziya karne se qasir hain. Baraye meharbani dobara koshish karein.
pages.treatmentUnverified: Is peshgoi ka ilaj abhi tasdeeq shuda nahi. Maqami zaraati mahir se mashwara karein.
pages.lowConfidence: Tasveer ki pehchan yaqini tor par nahi ho saki. Ek aur wazeh patte ki tasveer lein ya maqami zarai mahir se mashwara karein.
pages.uncertainTitle: Tasveer ko dobara dekhna zaroori hai

pages.consultAgricultureOfficer: Tasdeeq ke liye maqami zaraati afsar se mashwara karein.
